spec.body_markdown:
## Relative Error

Relative error expresses absolute error as a fraction of the true value, so errors from different-sized measurements can be fairly compared.

Relative error = absolute error / true value

- It is unitless (a plain fraction), since the units cancel out.
- A 1 cm error is enormous relative to a 2 cm paperclip (relative error 0.5) but negligible relative to a 100 m track (relative error 0.0001).
- Multiplying relative error by 100 gives percentage error.
